artworks.label: Cloud puppy leash
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for pocket-pup. One charming miniature puppy leash and matching collar, soft powder-blue woven strap curled in a loose graceful loop, ivory padded collar with a small dusty-peach heart-shaped tag bearing only a simple raised paw mark, tiny warm-brass clasp. Premium kawaii handmade felt/clay craft style, tactile soft fabric, rounded seams, gentle daylight, powder-blue/cream/peach palette. No dog, slipper, planter, mailbox, tin or biscuits; no writing on tag. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
